A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TeaserGen research work and complete, readable main text and Appendices A–H. Pages 3–18 render identically; differences on pages 1–2 are confined to the arXiv stamp and demo address.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations on 49 documentaries, a 20-participant subjective study, and ablation results in Section 5 and Appendices F–H.

after.justification: v2 retains the original objective evaluations, human-study results, and appendix experiments, including Tables 3–10.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same narration-generation procedure, TeaserGen-PT thresholding, and TeaserGen-LR architecture, diffusion prior, beam search, and smoothing.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,269-pair DocumentaryNet dataset and retain the same teaser-generation and narration-evaluation scenarios. No dataset, task, or domain coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Random selection, CLIP-NN, UniVTG, and CLIP-IT retain their respective participation in the reported comparisons. Comparator membership in the main-text and appendix experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: Training settings, the 49-documentary test set, evaluation metrics, and the subjective study using 10 documentaries and 20 participants are unchanged. Appendices C–H retain the same evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Section 5.6 and the appendices retain the same prompting, matching-score, smoothing, diffusion-prior, ground-truth-narration, finetuning, and regularization analyses. The narration examples in Tables 11–12 are also identical.

E5.justification: The uncertainty summaries in Tables 4, 5, and 8 are unchanged, including the explicit 95% confidence-interval description for Table 5. No seed or repeated-run information is added.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples in Tables 3–12 are identical. For example, title-query TeaserGen-PT retains F1 of 1.85% and scene change rate of 13.16% in Table 3.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, decoding objective in Equation (1), metric definitions in Equations (2)–(4), and accompanying assumptions are unchanged. No proof or derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same DocumentaryNet and TeaserGen contributions and the same claim favoring pretrained matching over directly trained sequential models.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and Section 6 limitations are identical, including objective–subjective metric discrepancies, narration-centered assumptions, interview face/name matching failures, and limited creative quality.

D1.justification: Footnote 1 changes the demo-link destination from TeaserDemo/ to TeaserGen_Official/ on the same host. Implementation details and release-upon-acceptance statements remain unchanged; the PDFs establish an address update, not increased resource availability.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, comparison tables, and positioning relative to trailer generation and multimodal summarization are identical.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp and demo-address text are updated. All substantive prose, terminology, headings, and section ordering remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–12 retain identical content, formatting, captions, and placement. The stamp and footnote text updates do not alter the document layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, limitations, and appendices are identical. Updating the demo address and version/date stamp establishes no meaningful overall quality improvement or deterioration; the PDFs do not demonstrate improved access or newly released resources.
